Issue 48 cover/date/11-poem count/cover narrative/read action replace standalone courtyard image and detached quotation. Recent editions show 47, 46 and 45 without repeating 48. Historical image and sharing metadata source retained.
implementation.cover_navigation: All generated front/back cover links open issue-N.html. Removed focus query and automatic-reader attribute; explicit Read quietly controls and existing reader code retained.
